hypothesis: An active SDR write fills one pending byte without restarting the active transfer.
competitor: An active SDR write restarts transmission or creates more than one pending byte.
test: Replay drained single-byte, active-write, two-active-write and idle-write controls against identical UF brackets.

outcomes.first preserved, one extra completion: Supports one pending byte; preserve the independent flag-boundary constraint.
outcomes.first delayed: Reject buffering-only model; inspect shift restart.
outcomes.third completion after late second ack: Reject one pending byte; investigate deeper queue or measurement state.

next_question: What distinguishes serial flag-latch phase from the delayed Timer-B observation near UF15/31?
